narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Idli is said for one and three, the numbers that go into three.
<bookmark mark='past'/>But the game does not stop at three, because the children keep on counting.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Idli must come again and again, so we need to keep counting on in threes.

narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>Skip counting in steps of a number gives the multiples of that number.
<bookmark mark='turn'/>Your turn. The children clap at every sixth number. At which numbers do they clap?
